scenarios.name: Buka Action Center (/actions vs /action-plans) & List Action Plans
scenarios.notes: Route /actions automatically redirects permanently to /action-plans. Stale mock data is completely removed. Real database plans are displayed.

scenarios.name: Detail Action Plan Lama (Fallback Alert/Cluster Null)
scenarios.notes: Old action plan detail loads without crashing, graceful fallback labels displayed.

scenarios.name: Generate Action Plan Baru via AI Generator dengan Konteks Alert/Cluster
scenarios.notes: Modal contains functional dropdown selectors for Alert and Narrative Cluster. Creation via modal sends alertId/clusterId properly.

scenarios.name: Detail Action Plan Baru dengan Relasi Alert & Cluster
scenarios.notes: New action plan detail view renders relations and steps accurately.

scenarios.name: Filter & Status Mapping di Action Center (No 429 on rapid navigation)
scenarios.notes: Status & priority filtering functions as expected. Rapid repeated navigation produced 0 HTTP 429 errors.

scenarios.name: Halaman Alerts & Cases (Mapping assignedTo/assignee_id & Layout)
scenarios.notes: Alert detail and cases assignment mapping intact. Critical incident card renders without visual overlap.

scenarios.name: Monitoring Console & Network Tab
scenarios.notes: Zero 429 errors on GET requests during entire workflow. POST generator endpoint remains strictly rate limited (returns 429 when spammed) as designed.
